page.title: Fren aɣawas-ik
page.subtitle: Beddel aɣawas melmi i k-yehwa. Axelleṣ yettwaḍemnen s tkarḍa CIB s SATIM.

change_plan.q: Zemreɣ ad beddleɣ aɣawas melmi i yi-yehwa?
change_plan.a: Ih, tzemreḍ ad tɛeddiḍ ɣer uɣawas yufraren neɣ yennernan melmi i k-yehwa. Ibeddilen ttwasnasen imir-a.

hidden_fees.a: Ulac tisuqqar yeffren. Ssuma i d-yettbanen tegber kullec: ulac tisuqqar n usebded, ulac takumisyunt ɣef uznuzu.

cancel.q: D acu ara yeḍrun ma sefsxeɣ ajerred-iw?
cancel.a: Ad teqqimeḍ tkeččmeḍ alamma tfuk tallit n tfaturt-ik. Isefka-k ad ttwaḥerzen 30 n wussan.

cta.title: Theggaḍ ad tbeddleḍ asalun-ik?
cta.subtitle: Rnu ɣer yigiman n yimsdaren yerḍan

test_mode.title: Askar n tirmit yermed
test_mode.description: Aql-ak deg twennaḍt n tirmit. Ixelleṣ ad ttwaserwesen s tesqamin timeẓyanin.

payment.info: Ma tsiteḍ ɣef "Kemmel ɣer uxelleṣ", ad tettwawehleḍ ɣer tɣerɣert taɣellsant n SATIM akken ad tfakkeḍ axelleṣ.
payment.security_notice: Axelleṣ-ik yettwaḍmen s uneggaf n SATIM
payment.accept_terms: Qebleɣ tiwtilin tigejdanin n uznuzu d tsertit n tbaḍnit
payment.terms_content: S uxelleṣ-a, ad tqebleḍ tiwtilin tigejdanin n uznuzu n Saloneo d tiwtilin n SATIM i usesfer n yixelleṣ.
payment.terms_content2: Axelleṣ-ik yettwaḍmen, talɣut-ik n tbankt ur tettwasekles ara ɣef yiqeddacen-nneɣ.
payment.terms_required: Ilaq ad tqebleḍ tiwtilin tigejdanin akken ad tkemmleḍ
payment.captcha_required: Ttxil-k, sentem captcha akken ad tkemmleḍ
